question: Magkano ang application fee at maximum tax cap sa pagkuha ng FSEC sa Bureau of Fire Protection?
answer: Ang application fee para sa pagkuha ng Fire Safety Certificate of Compliance (FSEC) sa Bureau of Fire Protection ay Php 200.00. Ang maximum tax cap ay 0.1% ng verified estimated value (materials at labor) ng building/structure o facility, hindi mas masamang Php [S3].

ground_truth: Applying for a Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC) requires an application fee of PHP 200.00 plus Fire Code Construction Tax (FCCT) of 0.1% of verified estimated value (materials and labor) up to PHP 50,000.00 maximum.
